items.title: Musk pledges to give ‘every kid in America’ one of his SpaceX shares

items.lede: Elon Musk says he plans to give one of his SpaceX shares to every child in the US starting next year. With around 72 million children in the US as of July 2025, Musk would be giving away about $10.5 billion worth of shares, according to a report from CNBC. Musk, who runs SpaceX and […]
items.title: Elon Musk promises to give one SpaceX share to every child in the US
